snapshot.title: Watch and reload changed item files
snapshot.description:
Add `internal/watch`: an fsnotify watcher on `.underdraw/items/` and `.underdraw/history/` with debouncing, so a `git checkout` touching many files triggers one reload.

On a change, the service reloads the affected items under its mutex.
- A changed item gets a new revision (above both the file's and the in-memory one) and a `CHANGE_TYPE_EXTERNAL_EDIT` entry with actor `ACTOR_TYPE_EXTERNAL`.
- New files are added and missing files are removed.
- Invalid files are logged and skipped; the previous in-memory version stays.
- The daemon's own writes must not be picked up as external edits (e.g. compare content to what it wrote).
